newsitem.title: CHINA: China foreign reserves reach $117.6 bln at end-May.
newsitem.headline: China foreign reserves reach $117.6 bln at end-May.

text.p: China's foreign exchange reserves reached $117.6 billion at the end of May, a rise of $12.6 billion from the start of the year, the State Planning Commission said in a report issued on Tuesday.

China's foreign reserves had reached $105 billion at the start of this year. The reserves were $112.06 billion at end-March. China has said it expects the reserves to grow by at least $20 billion this year.
